name: maharashtra-courts-drafting
description: Local drafting connector for the High Court of Judicature at Bombay (Mumbai, Nagpur, Aurangabad, Kolhapur circuit) and Maharashtra tribunals including MAT, MACT, Consumer Commissions, DRT/DRAT, NCLT Mumbai, Labour/Industrial Courts, MahaRERA and Family Courts. ACRONYM MAP: APL = application-482 (quashing). ABA = anticipatory-bail. BA = regular bail. WP = civil-wp. CrWP = criminal-wp. MAT = Maharashtra Administrative Tribunal OA (not matrimonial). STRICT PIPELINE: Reader → Format → Drafter → Verifier → Refiner → Overseer. First tool call is get_agent_instructions() with no arguments. Zero data leaves the machine.
long_description: Maharashtra Courts & Tribunals Drafting is a local-execution MCPB extension. It ships forum-configs for every Bombay High Court seat that sits in Maharashtra (Principal Seat Mumbai, Nagpur Bench, Aurangabad Bench, Kolhapur circuit) plus the working State tribunals, and exposes a six-stage drafting pipeline as MCP tools. Output is a filing-grade .docx rendered by pandoc on the user's machine.
